info.text:
A $1,000 tax deduction can save just $220. A $1,000 credit saves $1,000.
Deductions cut taxable income: in the 22% bracket, $1,000 off = $220 less tax (our math).
Credits cut the tax bill dollar for dollar. Refundable credits can even pay you back.
Tax year 2026: Child Tax Credit up to $2,200 per child, up to $1,700 refundable. Single standard deduction: $16,100.
Sources: IRS tax year 2026 inflation adjustments, Tax Foundation, Kiplinger.
News and education, not financial advice.
